description: The use-case card set runs without a named employee: scripts/eval_case_cards.py with --eval-principal reads the persistent host (PLX_WORKBENCH_STATE_DIR, PLX_WORKBENCH_HOST_CONFIG, the session ticket secret) as the declared eval principal (operating.eval_principal, examples/eval_principal.json: roles staff:operations and staff:sales, clearance internal, no marking, no action path, no Portal row, no Finance file), never as PLX_EVAL_READER even when it is set. Passes when the run is status run with reader.kind eval_principal and its declared roles in the report, and at least one card ran and one was answered (totals.run >= 1, totals.answered >= 1) in one real headless Claude Code session per card (the rotation's cases, 3 at once, none started after 1200 s). Coverage of the card set, never accuracy and never a permission proof: reader.a6_permission_proof says denied_leaks (A6) still requires PLX_EVAL_READER. --measure-only: a failed coverage rule exits 0 with its verdict recorded (eval.case_cards_answers holds the rule). Counts and enums only; transcripts stay in {tmp}.
notes: Live-unverified: spec only until the live check records a result. It needs the operator's Claude Code login and the persistent host's state, config and session ticket secret; the runner provisions whichever of the three the run leaves unset (verify/live_verify.py AGENT_HOST_CHECKS: a generated secret, a session state dir, examples/host.live-check.json) and names them, never their values, in detail.host_provisioned and PLX_WORKBENCH_HOST_PROVISIONED. PLX_EVAL_READER is not read (--eval-principal), so a host whose employee policy or config refuses the eval principal blocks the run (live_host_config_refused:<code> or live_host_identity_refused:<reason>) and no session starts. The rotation reads eval.case_cards_answers' cases_age from the daily report, so it takes the cases that check most needs. Keyless tests: operating/tests/test_eval_principal.py drives this command over a real operating.host start-up on a capture cycle's state (injected senders) with an injected agent transport, and checks this spec's expectations on that output (only agent_evidence differs). Budget: at most about 12 sessions, 3 at once, 300 s and 25 turns each, none started after 1200 s, inside 2100 s (no measured runtime yet: every run so far was blocked in under a second; 1200 s + one 300 s overrun + host start-up, re-size from the first run); daily at most, it spends the operator's Claude Code plan.
